0022600126.text: Memphis (2-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) visits Utah (1-2, 5th in the Northwest, 2 games back) on a two-game winning streak, with a 1-0 road record, while the Jazz have lost their last game. The teams have met once this season, a 123-103 Grizzlies win in Memphis on October 21, 2026, and the 2025-26 series was split 2-2. Memphis is missing Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle), and Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
